details:
Nexus (formerly Neon) is an executive dashboard for New Relic that rolls up the health of your entire estate into a single view. Aggregate Workloads across teams, business units, or regions onto one board: leadership gets a single-glance health check, and engineering teams get rapid-fire triage into the issues underneath.

Select any set of Workloads from your account in the Settings panel and Nexus will surface each one's current alert severity and open-issue counts side by side, so you always know where to look first.
whatsNew:
- Neon is now Nexus: rebuilt around New Relic Workloads with a new executive-dashboard experience
- Feature: Create and manage multiple boards, each with its own set of Workloads
- Feature: Mark a board as your default so it opens automatically
